patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Skin-colored, nontender, pearly papules with central umbilication on the abdomen and extremities

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Previously healthy, up-to-date immunizations, no significant illnesses.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Attends daycare three times per week.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: No fever, rash in other locations, itching, or systemic symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the pediatric patient presenting with multiple skin lesions.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: I have several skin-colored, smooth little bumps on my belly and arms/legs that don’t hurt and don’t itch. My mom noticed them recently, and kids at daycare have had similar bumps, but I don’t feel sick otherwise.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any swelling or pain in my joints. I feel okay otherwise.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual growths on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any bumps or sores on my scalp. I’m feeling fine and the bumps are only on my belly and arms/legs.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a sensation of itchiness lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I’m not itchy at all—the bumps don’t itch or hurt.

turns.doctor_question: Do you find it difficult to lift your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t have any trouble lifting my arms over my head. The bumps are just there on my belly and arms/legs, and I still feel normal otherwise.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my vision—things look the same to me, and I don’t have any eye pain either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t had any fever or felt extremely hot, dizzy, or very uncomfortable. I just noticed the little painless, skin-colored bumps on my belly and arms/legs and I feel totally normal otherwise.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t felt unusually stressed or overwhelmed—I’m playing and eating like usual. The only thing we noticed is those small, painless, skin-colored bumps on my belly and arms/legs.

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t have any burning or discomfort when I pee. I’m using the bathroom like normal and I feel totally fine otherwise.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills or a sudden cold sensation lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had chills or felt suddenly cold—I’m acting like myself and the bumps haven’t been bothering me.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast that feel fixed and don’t move when you touch them?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t have any breast lumps, and I haven’t noticed any fixed or unmoving bumps there. I only have the smooth, skin-colored little bumps on my belly and my arms/legs, and they don’t hurt or itch.

turns.doctor_question: Are you feeling any pain or discomfort in the side area of your abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any pain or discomfort on my belly between my ribs and hips. I feel fine, and I’ve only noticed the smooth, skin-colored bumps on my belly and arms/legs that don’t hurt or itch.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel pain in your calf when you walk, and does it go away when you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any pain in my calves when I walk, and it goes away the same way because I don’t really feel any pain to begin with.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your urine looks darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t think my pee looks darker than usual—I’m going to the bathroom like normal and my urine looks about the same as always. I feel totally fine otherwise.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have trouble lifting your arm fully overhead or reaching behind your back?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I can lift my arms up overhead and reach behind my back like normal. The bumps are only on my belly and my arms/legs, and they don’t hurt or itch.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your joints feel sore or stiff after doing the same activity repeatedly, like after a long day of typing, lifting, or other repetitive motions?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t feel sore or stiff after doing things, and my joints feel normal day to day. I’ve been playing and moving like usual, and the bumps still don’t hurt or itch.
